dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Hey, guess what? Grandma gave me a gift, wanna see it? Here. Grandma says it comes from the world outside. She says our ancestors brought it to the island when they first came here."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Oh, and she taught me a nursery rhyme, too. Umm... I think it goes like this:"

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "...<color=#37FFFF>Four winds bring the sound of joy</color>."
